name: Hard-constraint-first model reduction
decision_structure: A complex system admits many global explanations, but a small set of independently established local constraints can sharply reduce the admissible model space. The same strategy becomes dangerous when a model is preserved by bending or ignoring constraints that should instead falsify it.
rule: Lock only constraints whose reliability is independently high. Generate global models inside those constraints, and treat persistent violations of basic local constraints as evidence against the topology rather than as cosmetic imperfections. When discriminating data are weak, delay strong commitment and seek evidence capable of deciding among models.
operational_actions: Separate hard constraints from merely popular, convenient or low-resolution empirical regularities.
List the uncertainty and provenance of every constraint before model construction.
Freeze only constraints with independent support and lower uncertainty than the rest of the model.
Generate candidate models under those constraints instead of optimizing global elegance first.
Run a constraint-violation audit: steric, charge, measurement, logical or identification constraints depending on the field.
If a model repeatedly violates a hard constraint, change or abandon the topology before adding more free parameters.
If an external empirical regularity conflicts with otherwise strong local constraints, test whether that regularity is truly local/universal before deforming the model to fit it.
Delay strong claims when available evidence cannot discriminate among several precise models.
boundary_conditions: The supposedly hard constraints must be independently reliable rather than inherited from convention.
The target problem must actually contain constraints structurally analogous to those in the source episode.
A successful model in one domain does not license transferring its substantive chemistry/physics into another domain.
Model elegance, symmetry or narrative coherence cannot override contradictory high-quality evidence.
failure_signals: A candidate requires repeated violation or deformation of a basic local constraint.
Key parameters are chosen mainly to preserve the preferred global topology.
The model is described as precise while the evidence needed to discriminate it has not been collected or analyzed.
Known anomalies are repeatedly relabeled as details to be refined later.
A low-resolution empirical pattern is treated as a universal hard constraint without testing its scope.

validation_record.positive_case_evidence: 1951 primary publication + Pauling first-person oral history + OSU archival reconstruction
validation_record.negative_case_evidence: 1953 primary publication + OSU archival reconstruction + Peter Pauling participant retrospective

notes: Golden Set v0.2 strengthens the heuristic with an explicit success/failure contrast. It remains provisional rather than validated because the most important process-level contemporaneous archive objects have not yet been directly inspected.
